{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
df = pd.read_csv('data/sales.csv')

# Clean revenue: remove commas and convert to float
df['revenue_clean'] = pd.to_numeric(df['revenue'].str.replace(',', ''), errors='coerce')

# Identify QA orders: those with revenue = 999999.99 (in cleaned form)
qa_orders = df[df['revenue_clean'] == 999999.99]
print(f"Found {len(qa_orders)} QA orders to exclude")

# Identify refunded orders
refunded_orders = df[df['status'] == 'refunded']
print(f"Found {len(refunded_orders)} refunded orders to exclude")

# Combine exclusion criteria: QA orders OR refunded orders
df_filtered = df[~((df['revenue_clean'] == 999999.99) | (df['status'] == 'refunded'))]
print(f"Final number of orders after excluding QA and refunded: {len(df_filtered)}")

# Compute total revenue per channel
total_revenue_by_channel = df_filtered.groupby('channel', as_index=False)['revenue_clean'].sum()
print("Total revenue by channel after exclusions:")
print(total_revenue_by_channel)

# Find the channel with the highest total revenue
best_channel = total_revenue_by_channel.loc[total_revenue_by_channel['revenue_clean'].idxmax()]['channel']
print(f"Channel with highest total revenue: {best_channel}")"}
